name: spl-binary-option
description: A primitive binary option: two parties take the long and the short side of an event, each depositing collateral, and trade positions as minted long and short tokens.

name: spl-binary-oracle-pair
description: Mints a pass token and a fail token for every deposit; after the decision window, an oracle picks the outcome and only the winning token redeems.

name: spl-feature-proposal
description: Proposes a new cluster feature and mints tokens for the participants; once enough of them are sent to the proposal's acceptance account before the deadline, a tally activates the feature.

name: spl-memo
description: A simple program that validates a string of UTF-8 encoded characters and logs it in the transaction log.

name: spl-name-service
description: A spl program for issuing and managing ownership of: domain names, Solana Pubkeys, URLs, twitter handles, ipfs cid's, metadata, etc...

name: spl-record
description: Stores arbitrary data in an account that only its authority can write, update or close.

name: spl-shared-memory
description: Lets a program called through a cross-program invocation hand data back to its caller, by copying instruction data into a shared account.

name: spl-stake-pool
description: A program for pooling together SOL to be staked by an off-chain agent running a Delegation Bot which redistributes the stakes across the network and tries to maximize censorship resistance and rewards.

name: spl-stateless-asks
description: Swaps one token for another with no escrow account: the maker approves a program-derived authority and any taker fills the offer in one transaction.

name: token-vesting
description: Bonfida's token vesting: locks tokens under a schedule and releases each portion to the recipient once its unlock time passes.
